# Archived Lily reference notices

The former `stark_lily_core` executor has been removed. This directory contains
only retained license, attribution and historical provenance records.

Production Qwen3.8 inference uses the standard Uzu `LanguageModel` API and
architecture blocks documented in
[Qwen3.8 Uzu execution](../../docs/QWEN38_UZU_EXECUTION_PLAN.md). Native exports
with the historical Lily format marker require conversion before loading.

See [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md), [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [NOTICE](NOTICE).
